name: io.github.Grinv/anilist-mcp-server
title: AniList MCP Server
description: MCP server for the AniList GraphQL API — anime/manga search, details, and personal list management.

environmentVariables.name: ANILIST_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. From an app registered at anilist.co/settings/developer — needed to use login_anilist.

environmentVariables.name: ANILIST_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Paired with the Client ID above — needed to use login_anilist.

environmentVariables.name: ANILIST_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A pre-obtained AniList access token, as an alternative to running login_anilist.

environmentVariables.name: ANILIST_OAUTH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Localhost port for the login_anilist callback (default 8082).

environmentVariables.name: ANILIST_TOKEN_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides where the AniList access token is persisted (defaults under the OS config dir).
